message: esbuild has install scripts that Bun will not run because depcurfew.json does not allow it; esbuild does not need them: it only puts the binary, which esbuild takes from an optional dependency for the platform, in place of the esbuild command and checks that it runs (depcurfew checked esbuild 0.28.2; the lockfile has 0.21.5, so check that it works the same)
fix: Add esbuild to installScripts.deny in depcurfew.json, and keep optional dependencies installed: esbuild works without its install script then
